value.rationale: The complete exact Euclidean circumsphere classification across k=2,...,10 identifies the first sharp contact-set collapse, k=10, for a family whose facet complexity was recently studied. It provides rational centers, squared radii and exact contact sets throughout a natural first-transition range, distinguishing minimax from the prior diameter and covariance statistics. The finite cutoff is motivated by the actual first change of equality structure; no arbitrary extrapolation is claimed.
